_comment: Attack/spell SE stop after minimise/resume. AudioObject._OnPlay never clears _applicationPaused (+0x65), and Update skips completion/pool-return while it is set; the capped AudioObject pool then runs dry (ObjectPoolController.GetPooledInstance returns null) and every Master Audio SE stays silent until an app restart. 0xCA5468 clears both pause bytes on every play; 0xCA55A4 removes the Update gate. BGM is unaffected (separate MusicManager).
